parsed.diagnosis: Minimized runs show FDIR isolates a mildly degraded friction wheel with residual 4-5e-04 Nm just above threshold, then a second fault dominates. Saturation traces separately show NOMINAL error hovering at 15-16 deg for hundreds of seconds, triggering repeated SAFE sun-point slews that pump wheels to saturation, while no-policy runs ride through clean. The 15-deg watchdog is too close to nominal tracking error and causes policy-induced cycling.
parsed.rationale: Raise attitude watchdog from 15 to 18 deg to filter marginal 15-16 deg nuisance trips. Representative saturation cases trigger SAFE at 15.9, 15.4, 15.2 deg; with 18 deg they stay in NOMINAL like the clean no-policy run and avoid SAFE-induced momentum buildup. True losses with 30-170 deg errors still exceed 18 deg for 120s, so SAFE protection is preserved with only seconds delay, well below the 30-deg requirement.
parsed.why_no_regressions: 18 deg remains 12 deg below the 30-deg safety limit and only suppresses SAFE in the 15-18 deg band which is inherently safe. No change to FDIR, battery thresholds, or resume dwell, so single-fault and severe multi-fault behavior is unchanged.
